synopsis: Song Yunxiang, humanity's final mecha-sorceror, was reborn back to his schoolboy days with a powerful System. This time, back on campus, he will use his newfound power to create new mecha and destroy the monsters… All his regrets, all the friends that he missed, this time he will not make the same mistakes.
